I'm really touched that you'd want me there, and it means a lot that our work together has felt so meaningful to you. Watching you reach this milestone is something I'm genuinely proud of—though I want to gently remind you that the real credit belongs to you. Your effort, persistence, and courage got you here.

Because of the professional boundaries that keep our work focused and safe, I won't be able to attend the ceremony itself. That's not a reflection of how much I value your accomplishment—it's actually a way of protecting the kind of relationship that helped you get here. I hope we can spend time in our next session celebrating what you've achieved and talking about what comes next for you.

Congratulations. This is a huge accomplishment, and you deserve to feel proud of yourself.
